cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1 and D2 on top of cwc-1. (1) packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml gains [workspace.lints.clippy] too_many_arguments = "allow" and result_large_err = "allow"; crates/bee/Cargo.toml and crates/fleet/Cargo.toml gain [lints] workspace = true. Nothing else is allowed. (2) Fix every remaining finding of cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings in code, behavior unchanged: type_complexity with a type alias; large_enum_variant by boxing the large variant; doc lints by fixing the doc text indentation; dead_code: delete the item only when rg shows no caller in any target (tests included), otherwise make it used where it is meant to be or gate it with cfg(test) if only tests use it; private_interfaces by aligning visibility; the rest as clippy suggests. No #[allow] attribute on any item and no new code comment. (3) .bee/config.json: the clippy entry of commands.test ends in ' -- -D warnings'; .github/workflows/ci.yml clippy step runs cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings. Keep proof_gate green (adjust its expectations only if it pins the old clippy text). (4) docs/knowledge/areas/verify-pipeline/suite-topology-and-discovery.md: the commands.test sentence says clippy runs with -D warnings and the two workspace allows, citing clippy-warnings-clean D1/D2 (never raw ids). Run bee knowledge check. Commit once (cell trailer). Proof: the verify command; quote the counts.
